content_metadata.title: Why Do We Need Anticipatory AI-Governance?

trimmingSuggestions.description: Scenes 1 and 2 could be significantly shortened by intercutting with B-roll footage related to AI, governance, or technology conferences.

text_to_speech: AI as every emerging technology is a moving target that’s why we need a regime of soft and hard regulatory instruments from self constrained standards to legislation, also at the international level, in order to be able to cope. Our ambition is to bring people into the room that not only talk about AI but also do AI from the policy side but also from the industry in order to explore pathways to act in the immediate future but also in the in the middle term having always in mind the EU capacity to act at a global level
